brand.name: Sunup Garage Sales
brand.tagline: Your garage back by Sunday night.

owner.name: Ramona Pike
owner.heading: The person who works your driveway
owner.bio: Ramona Pike has been the first car at Saturday-morning sales since she was tall enough to see over a card table. After years of running sales for moving neighbors and downsizing friends, she made it official — a small crew, a trailer full of folding tables, and one simple promise: you hand us the garage, and we hand it back empty. Ramona still prices every sale herself and works every sale day from the first early bird to the last box on the donation truck.

pricing.note: One commission on what sells, agreed in writing before we book your date — nothing to pay up front.

hero.kicker: Garage sales · Moving sales · Downsizing days
hero.title: You don't want a garage sale. You want the garage back.
hero.subtitle: Sunup runs garage and moving sales across Pocatello and the Portneuf Valley. We sort, stage, price and sign everything, staff the whole sale day, and haul or donate whatever's left. You don't even have to be home.

about.heading: Nobody actually wants to run a garage sale
about.body: The pricing decisions, the 6 a.m. start, the haggling, the pile of unsold stuff at 4 p.m. — that's the part people dread, and that's the part we take. We run the sale on your driveway, on your behalf: your things stay yours until a shopper pays for them, and everything ends with an itemized settlement sheet and an empty garage. One thing we'll never do is guess out loud what your sale will bring — nobody honestly can. What we promise is the work.

howItWorks.title: Sort & stage
howItWorks.desc: We walk the garage with you and flag anything the family keeps. Then the crew sorts the rest into categories and stages the driveway — everything up on tables, best items nearest the street.

howItWorks.title: Price & sign
howItWorks.desc: Every category gets priced to actually sell, small items get bundled, and our corner signs go up around the neighborhood the night before — big letters, driver height.

howItWorks.title: Sale day, staffed
howItWorks.desc: We work the sale from early birds to the last hour: greeting, haggling, cash and card checkout. You can watch from the kitchen window or leave town entirely.

howItWorks.title: Leftovers hauled or donated
howItWorks.desc: Whatever hasn't sold by close gets donated or hauled away by arrangement. You get the garage back swept, with an itemized settlement sheet of everything that sold.

prepTips.title: Everything off the ground
prepTips.desc: Items on the floor don't sell. We bring folding tables and raise everything to waist height — even a sheet of plywood on sawhorses outsells a tarp on the lawn.

prepTips.title: Best things face the street
prepTips.desc: A driver decides in two seconds whether to stop. The furniture, tools and big pieces go nearest the curb, where they do the advertising for everything behind them.

prepTips.title: Make a walkway, not a wall
prepTips.desc: Tables form a corridor shoppers walk through, so they end up seeing everything — a single line of tables across the driveway is a barricade, not a sale.

prepTips.title: Signs get four words
prepTips.desc: A driver thirty feet away has time for about four big words and an arrow. Our signs go up on the corners the night before, at eye height for a driver — not knee height on a fence.

prepTips.title: Price by category, then bundle
prepTips.desc: We sort first and price whole categories at once instead of agonizing item by item. Small stuff gets bundled — 'fill a bag' moves volume and saves hours of tagging.

prepTips.title: A markdown plan empties the garage
prepTips.desc: The point of the last day is a clear garage, not a full one. We set the markdown schedule with you in advance, so the sale ends on purpose instead of fizzling out.

contact.heading: Get your Saturday back
contact.body: Call or text and we'll set up a free driveway walkthrough — usually a weekday evening, about twenty minutes. We'll look at what you've got, explain the fee structure, and if it's a fit, put a sale date on the calendar in writing.
contact.hours: Walkthroughs weekday evenings · Sale days Friday & Saturday, 8 AM – 4 PM
